description:
Blocks a clean merge of the ollama-port branch. Two different AI Decision documents both numbered AID-0055:

* main:        docs/ai-decisions/AID-0055-type1-charstrings-from-spec-not-hayro.md (the hayro-font/Type1 decision, referenced by crates/kopitiam-pdf/src/mupdf/hayro_fallback.rs's module docs)
* ollama-port: docs/ai-decisions/AID-0055-ollama-port-crate-boundary.md

Both branched off the same base and independently took the next free number. A git merge will NOT flag this as a conflict -- the filenames differ, so both files land side by side and the index table in docs/ai-decisions/README.md ends up with two 0055 rows.

Per CLAUDE.md an AID is never deleted, even when reversed, so the fix is to RENUMBER one (ollama-port's is the natural one to move, since main's is already referenced from shipped code), update docs/ai-decisions/README.md's index table, and grep for inbound references before/after. Do this BEFORE merging ollama-port, not after.
title: AID-0055 number collision: ollama-port and main both claim it
